evidence_articles.title: 97% Of Women In Punjab To Get Financial Aid From July 1: Bhagwant Mann
evidence_articles.rephrased: **Bhagwant Mann**, the **Punjab Chief Minister**, announced that women registered under the Mukh Mantri Mawan Dheeyan Satkar Yojna will receive monthly financial assistance starting July 1st. The sche
evidence_articles.content: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann has said women registered under the Mukh Mantri Mawan Dheeyan Satkar Yojna will start getting Rs 1,000 monthly financial assistance from July 1. Under the state government's ambitious scheme, women beneficiaries from the general category will receive a monthly assistance of Rs 1,000, while those from the scheduled castes will get Rs 1,500. "Funds will be directly transferred to beneficiaries' bank accounts, and women who are already receiving social security pensions will also be eligible under the scheme. Around 97 per cent of women in Punjab are expected to benefit from this initiative, and the Punjab Government has allocated Rs 9,300 crore in the budget for its implementation," he stated. There were a total of 52 lakh women beneficiaries, Mann said, of which 36 lakh have been issued cards under the scheme. "From July 1, the money will be transferred to their bank accounts," he said. The chief minister asserted that the scheme will not be stopped. "We started this scheme when we had a proper budget for it," he told reporters here. "Women deserve the highest respect because they are the source of life itself. The blessings of mothers and sisters can help overcome every challenge in the world. Strengthening women's financial autonomy is essential for improving household welfare, promoting gender equity and enhancing women's participation in social and economic decision-making," he said. Women aged 18 years or above, who are registered as voters in Punjab and possess valid Aadhaar cards reflecting Punjab residency, will be eligible to be enrolled as a beneficiary. "Around two lakh Mahila Satkar Sakhis have been assigned the responsibility of registering eligible beneficiaries," he said. Those excluded from the scheme include regular or retired employees of the Punjab government, Central government or any other state or UT governments; elected MLAs or MPs; and spouses of serving ministers, MPs or MLAs. The Rs 1,000 monthly assistance per woman was a key poll promise of the ruling Aam Aadmi Party before the 2022 Punjab assembly elections. "This initiative will go a long way in empowering women across Punjab and ensuring that they are able to lead their lives with dignity and confidence," he added. recent_articles.title: 97% Of Women In Punjab To Get Financial Aid From July 1: Bhagwant Mann
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bhagwant Mann**, the **Punjab Chief Minister**, announced that women registered under the Mukh Mantri Mawan Dheeyan Satkar Yojna will receive monthly financial assistance starting July 1st. The scheme provides Rs 1,000 to general category women and Rs 1,500 to those from scheduled castes.  **Mann** stated that around 97% of Punjab's women are expected to benefit from this initiative, with the government allocating Rs 9,300 crore for its implementation. The scheme aims to empower women and promote gender equity.

recent_articles.title: From corridors of power: Sunil Jakhar’s tragedy, CM Mann’s walk that never was and Rahul Gandhi’s ‘third warning’ | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunil Jakhar**, a prominent figure in Punjab politics, has faced repeated setbacks as he continues to be passed over for leadership positions.  **Rahul Gandhi** delivered a "third warning" to **Punjab Congress** leaders regarding their performance in the recent municipal elections, which saw significant losses. Meanwhile, **CM Bhagwant Mann's** planned early-morning walk with morning walkers was canceled at the last minute. The relationship between former Chief Minister **Captain Amarinder Singh** and newly appointed **BJP** chief **Kewal Dhillon** has been strained by **Amarinder's** public criticism of **Dhillon's** appointment.

recent_articles.title: Dimpy Dhillon of AAP gets third-time lucky - The Tribune
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dimpy Dhillon**, a leading transporter, won the Gidderbaha bypoll for **AAP**, defeating his nearest rival, **Amrita Waring** of the Congress.  Dhillon secured 71,644 votes, while Waring received 49,675. The victory marks the first AAP MLA from this constituency and follows a week-long postponement of the election. Dhillon's win is attributed to factors such as his previous losses in the area, public sympathy for him, development initiatives by the state government, and a strong campaign led by **CM Bhagwant Mann** and national convener **Arvind Kejriwal**.

recent_articles.title: People defeated opposition’s politics of hatred: Punjab CM Mann on civic poll outcome - The Tribune
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** has won over 860 of the 1,977 wards in Punjab's civic body elections, leading in many others.  **Bhagwant Mann**, Punjab Chief Minister, expressed satisfaction with the results, attributing the victory to the people rejecting "opposition's politics of hatred" and supporting AAP's development agenda. The party secured a significant win despite facing opposition from **BJP**, **Congress**, and **SAD**.

recent_articles.title: Aam Aadmi Party scores big in Punjab civic elections - The Tribune
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** secured a resounding victory in Punjab's urban local body elections, winning control of five municipal corporations and nine nagar panchayats.  **Bhagwant Mann**, the Chief Minister, hailed the outcome as "historic" and attributed it to AAP's model of good governance. The party also performed strongly in 19 nagar panchayats, securing a majority in most areas. **Manish Sisodia**, AAP Punjab affairs in-charge, emphasized the landslide victory as a testament to the people's endorsement of their model.  The Congress finished second, while Independents secured third place.

recent_articles.title: How Municipal Poll Setback Brought Congress Factionalism To Fore In Punjab
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Congress** suffered a disappointing performance in the Punjab municipal elections, losing to the ruling **Aam Aadmi Party**. This setback has reignited concerns about leadership within the party and fueled internal power struggles. Several senior leaders are positioning themselves for key organizational roles ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections.  While the high command has stated there will be no immediate organizational changes, factionalism remains a significant challenge for the party as it seeks to address accountability and build unity for future electoral success.

recent_articles.title: Punjab government to remove stray dogs from high footfall public spaces following Supreme Court order - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bhagwant Mann**, Punjab Chief Minister, announced that the state government will remove stray dogs from all high footfall public spaces as per **Supreme Court** directions issued on May 19, 2026.  The move aims to ensure public safety and provide relief to citizens concerned about stray dog attacks. The government plans to create adequate shelters for stray dogs while adhering to the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act and ABC Rules regarding euthanasia in cases involving dangerous or rabid animals.

recent_articles.title: Punjab worse than West Bengal under AAP rule, says Haryana CM Saini - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini** criticized the **AAP government in Punjab**, accusing it of failing to control drug trafficking, illegal mining, and lawlessness. He compared the current situation in Punjab to West Bengal under **Mamata Banerjee**, stating that people are disillusioned with the AAP and seeking change through the BJP's governance model.  Saini also contrasted the BJP's policies with those of the Congress, highlighting the latter's corruption and lack of focus on people's welfare.

recent_articles.title: Saini urges Punjab OBCs to back BJP in Assembly polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini** urged the OBC community in Punjab to unite and support the **BJP** in the upcoming Assembly elections. He claimed that the party ensures equal representation and criticized the Aam Aadmi Party government's performance, citing disillusionment with poll promises.  Saini highlighted the community's contributions to nation-building and alleged they have been denied opportunities in Punjab. He urged them to support the BJP, referencing measures under Prime Minister Narendra Modi for OBC representation, reservation in education, and constitutional status for the OBC Commission.

recent_articles.title: High drama in Punjab Assembly; Congress, Akali Dal allege CM Mann was drunk during House proceedings - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Opposition parties in Punjab, including the Congress and Shiromani Akali Dal, have accused **Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann** of appearing intoxicated during a session of the Vidhan Sabha.  They demanded an alcohol test and called for dope testing of all MLAs.  Congress leader Sukhpal Singh Khaira urged **Arvind Kejriwal**, the national convener of the Aam Aadmi Party, to take action against **Mann**. Rajya Sabha MP Swati Maliwal also accused **Mann** of being intoxicated at public events and demanded an alcohol test. The Congress Legislative Party has formally written to the Speaker requesting immediate alco-meter and dope testing of all members.  Finance Minister Harpal Singh Cheema refuted the allegations, calling them false and baseless.

recent_articles.title: Rajya Sabha Chairman accepts merger of seven AAP MPs with BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **C.P. Radhakrishnan**, the **Rajya Sabha Chairman**, accepted the merger of seven **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** MPs with the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**, increasing the BJP's strength in the Upper House to 113 and reducing AAP to three members. The move followed a significant political realignment in the Rajya Sabha on April 24th, when seven of the AAP's ten members joined the BJP. **Arvind Kejriwal**, the AAP national convener, criticized the BJP for betraying Punjabis.

recent_articles.title: AAP MPs walk out, casting shadow over 2027 Assembly polls in Punjab - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Seven AAP parliamentarians**, six from Punjab, resigned on Friday, April 24, 2026, potentially jeopardizing the party's chances in the upcoming 2027 state assembly elections. **Bhagwant Mann**, Punjab Chief Minister, criticized the BJP for its tactics while acknowledging the defections reveal internal struggles within the party. Opposition parties seized on the defections to highlight AAP's challenges ahead of the elections.

recent_articles.title: Punjab Assembly passes Bill with strict provisions against acts of sacrilege - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Punjab Assembly** unanimously passed a Bill increasing penalties for sacrilege against the Guru Granth Sahib, including life imprisonment and fines up to ₹25 lakh.  Chief Minister **Bhagwant Mann** presented the Jaagat Jot Sri Guru Granth Sahib Satkar (Amendment) Bill, 2026, emphasizing its aim to address past loopholes in protecting the holy book. The bill was lauded as a historic step towards safeguarding the sanctity of the Guru Granth Sahib and promoting harmony among people.

recent_articles.title: Punjab: Special session on sacrilege law an attempt by AAP Government to cover up its failures, says Congress chief - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Amrinder Singh Raja Warring**, **Bhagwant Mann**, and the **AAP Government** in Punjab are at odds over a proposed law to punish sacrilege.  The **Punjab Congress** president criticized the special session called by the AAP government, claiming it is an attempt to distract from their failure to punish those responsible for previous sacrilege incidents. Warring also questioned the sincerity of the AAP's intentions and accused them of using the issue as a political tool. He further pointed out that the law lacks any real deterrent effect without proper punishment.

recent_articles.title: Punjab Minister Bhullar resigns from Cabinet as Opposition demands murder case, CBI probe - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Laljit Singh Bhullar**, Punjab’s Transport Minister, resigned from the **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** government on Saturday after a video surfaced showing him allegedly pressuring district manager Gagandeep Singh Randhawa to award a tender to his associate. The incident led to calls for an FIR under murder charges against **Bhullar** and the transfer of the case to the Central Bureau of Investigation by opposition parties, including the Congress, Shiromani Akali Dal, and the Bharatiya Janata Party. Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann ordered an inquiry but faced criticism from opposition leaders who questioned his leadership and competence.
